_comment: THE NIGHTLY'S PER-LEG TIME BUDGET, in minutes, read by .github/workflows/certify.yml.
One entry per registered leg (make/<lang>.mk's TEST_LEGS), plus 'core' for
`make test` with every leg skipped. certify.yml's test-legs job refuses a
registered leg with no entry here and an entry naming no registered leg, so
this file and `make registry` cannot drift apart.
EVERY NUMBER IS A MEASUREMENT PLUS HEADROOM, never a guess. Measure with
`time make test-<leg>` (and `time make test SCHEMA_SKIP_LEGS='<all legs>'`
for core) on a quiet box, or read the duration off the leg's own job in the
last green nightly, which is the runner these numbers are for. The headroom
is roughly double, because a GitHub runner is shared hardware and a leg that
runs long is a regression worth a red rather than a flake worth a retry.
A leg that outgrows its budget is killed and NAMES ITSELF: the certified job
turns the run red and prints the leg. Raise the number only with a new
measurement in the pull request that raises it.
